# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.5.7-beta

Independent enabling-product versions can support main-product design, data evaluation and tests through explicit adoption.

- Recorder and Replay retain independent release and approval histories.
- New versions, datasets, compatibility and adoption use existing serial Owner Claims and human review.
- Exact protocol/environment checks and upgrade impact previews protect the consuming work.
- Read-only legacy-work handoff previews prepare new bilingual drafts with source and Owner provenance.

### Compatibility

Existing registries remain readable. Product governance uses explicit registry 1.3 / contract 0.5.7 adoption with an immutable prior snapshot. Older clients reject writing that contract.

### Approval boundary

Historical imports retain local identity declarations and original scope. Main-product adoption requires its own governed applicability decision. One Claim and one review subject remain enforced.

### Known limitations

Repository citations are declared provenance with locally checked content hashes. Content readiness and authenticated platform approval mapping retain their own planned versions. No private Golden fixture was available.

### 兼容性

现有登记继续可读。子产品治理须显式采纳注册表 1.3 / 契约 0.5.7，并保留旧快照。旧客户端拒绝写入新契约。

### 审批边界

历史导入保留原适用范围和本地身份声明。新版本、数据、兼容性与主产品采用分别经过现有串行 Claim 和人工评审。主产品采用有独立的适用性决定。

### 已知限制

本版核对本地内容摘要，仓库出处属于声明信息。内容就绪评审、平台认证审批映射保留在各自规划版本中。本轮没有可用私有 Golden。
